deadline.value: Funded PhD posts are advertised as separate vacancies on the TU/e vacancies page, so there is no single programme deadline.
deadline.quote: If you want to become an employed PhD candidate, you apply for a funded position listed on the TU/e vacancies page

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Without an advertised vacancy you need a TU/e supervisor's agreement and a research proposal before admission.
supervisor.quote: A research proposal and agreement from a TU/e supervisor (if you do not apply through a vacancy)

funding.value: Most PhD candidates at TU/e are employed and paid a salary; self-funded candidates must arrange their own funding.
funding.quote: Most PhD candidates are employed by TU/e

also.quote: As a non-employed PhD candidate, you must arrange your own funding

entry_route.value: A Dutch master's degree, or a foreign equivalent that TU/e assesses case by case, is expected before starting.
entry_route.quote: A Dutch Master’s degree (or foreign equivalent) in a relevant field

also.quote: Not every foreign preparatory and/or master's program automatically gives you access to a Dutch PhD track

notes: No department admission page was found; the university PhD rules apply. The department page refers to 'PDEng and PhD candidates'. Biomedical Engineering is saved; biomedical sciences and biology have no official TU/e PhD on the pages fetched.
